- Your stated needs: ~150 req/sec peak for the payments routing use case, low ~100-200ms per-request P50, and strict controls around PII/logging retention.

1) Would you prefer we spin up a Hosted trial first, or jump to a Dedicated pool for predictable throughput?
2) Any procurement/security docs we should prep in parallel (SLA, SOC2 evidence, DPA)?

Next steps I propose:
- I can provision a Hosted eval project for you by tomorrow (API key + 30k free tokens). That will let you validate integration and latency.
- If you hit rate limits we can request a temporary quota increase for the Hosted trial or discuss Dedicated (reserved) capacity for 24/7 150rps+ throughput.
- Tech touch: Dev will join a short call if you want to validate firewall/networking or private deployment concerns.

Resources attached: Redwood-Hosted-API-Quickstart.pdf (quick curl examples, endpoints, token limits) and an evaluation-checklist.xlsx you can use for procurement. Also linking the quickstart for convenience: https://app.redwood.com/quickstart/heliospay

Hey James / Priya — quick technical answers inline: 

- Default Hosted rate limits: we start new orgs at 20 requests/sec with burst handling; for evaluations we commonly grant temporary quota increases (we've provisioned up to 100-150 rps for pilot windows within 24-48 hours depending on capacity). For sustained 150 rps with SLOs, Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) is the right fit.

- Endpoints / quickstart: Use the base URL https://api.redwood.com/v1/ with your org API key. Example (curl):

  curl -s "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":150}'

Streaming is supported via chunked responses; recommended for low-latency UX.

- Token limits: per-request token limit is 8k tokens for the 7b variant, and we throttle on tokens/minute as well as requests/sec. For small prompts (~100 tokens) 150 rps is mostly an RPS concern.

- Security/logging: Hosted logs capture request metadata and hashed identifiers by default. We offer configurable retention windows and can suppress raw input logging for regulated pilots (set during onboarding). For SIEM integration we can forward structured audit logs to a customer-managed endpoint (S3/Kinesis) on Dedicated or via secure syslog on Private setups.

- Network: Hosted doesn't require fixed egress IPs; if you need IP allowlisting we can provide a set of CIDR ranges for our egress endpoints, or recommend a Private deployment (VPC) for strict network controls.

I'll join tomorrow's sync to walk through the curl examples and validate the integration.

Regards,
